documents.rightsNotes: HOLD per docs/country-research/kenya-constitution-2010-preflight.md (decision 8 Nov 2026; addendum 11 Nov 2026). Two candidate rights routes: (1) express NCLR commercial/AI licence (template: docs/rights-requests/kenya-nclr-licensing-request.md); (2) statutory exclusion — Copyright Act Cap 130 defines literary work to exclude a written law or judicial decision; requires legal-reviewer sign-off. Currentness: no enacted amendment verified as at 11 Nov 2026 (Senate Bills No. 7 of 2026 and 2025 Bills not traced to assent/Gazette). Do not import until both gates are signed off; then acquire the current consolidated NCLR text, verify against Gazette and amendment instruments, populate fullText and sections, and dry-run the importer.
